title: 成人の日の和風イラスト
subject_en: Coming-of-age day items, each a separate item, refined Japanese illustration style, rich reds, golds and purples, faces shown simply as in a gentle Japanese picture style Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white.
lead: 振袖、袴、扇子、花飾りなど成人式の素材12点です。お祝いカードや式典案内に使えます。
items: a long-sleeved red furisode kimono with floral pattern, displayed alone on a stand
a dark navy hakama with a crest-free haori displayed alone
an open gold folding fan with a crane pattern
a hair ornament of silk flowers with dangling beads
a pair of gold zori sandals and a small matching bag
a rolled ornate obi sash with a decorative cord
a large bouquet of chrysanthemum and ranunculus in red and white
a white crane with spread wings
a red and white mizuhiki knot
a smiling young woman in a red furisode, full body, no real person
a smiling young man in a navy hakama, full body, no real person
